root_cause: Circular preroll_buf was updated with the current chunk before taking [preroll_buf.copy() chunk.copy()] causing the onset frame to appear twice consecutively
corrective_fix: Update preroll_buf only during WAITING when is_speech is False; on onset copy preroll_buf containing audio strictly preceding onset chunk

issue_name: Missing Speech Duration Validation on Valley Splitting
root_cause: Valley splitting partitioned and finalized seg1 without verifying whether seg1 accumulated >= min_speech_samples (100ms) of active speech
corrective_fix: Calculate seg1 active speech duration and enforce seg1_active_speech >= min_speech_samples before allowing valley split finalization

root_cause: Valley splitting re-armed seg2 with active_speech_samples = sum(len(c) for c in seg2_chunks) which falsely counted low-energy valley dip silence as speech
corrective_fix: Maintain per-chunk is_speech boolean history (chunk_is_speech) and compute seg1/seg2 active speech exclusively over chunks where is_speech is True

root_cause: Lack of boundary consistency check on split_idx range and parallel state arrays
corrective_fix: Enforce 2 <= split_idx < len(accumulated_chunks) and slice accumulated_chunks chunk_dbs chunk_ratios and chunk_is_speech with identical split_idx

root_cause: Pending valid utterances at stream termination were trapped in ACCUMULATING state and dropped if trailing silence was shorter than silence_interval_ms
corrective_fix: Implement explicit flush() method on segmenters and LiveKWSPipeline to finalize and emit any pending segment with >= min_speech_samples

issue_name: Game Mode Session Reset & Buffer Leakage
root_cause: open_session and close_session did not strictly purge underlying segmenter state risking cross-session audio or telemetry carryover
corrective_fix: Invoke segmenter.reset() on both open_session() and close_session() and reset internal clock and gate state completely
